newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso ends higher vs dlr at 1,075.50.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso ends higher vs dlr at 1,075.50.

text.p: Colombia's peso, buoyed by dollar sales by coffee and oil exporters, ended 1.75 pesos higher against the dollar at 1,075.50 in active trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.

"The (exchange) rate collapsed after about 11 a.m. local time and it was expected to go as low as 1,074," one trader said. He said the dollar cut some of its losses ahead of the close, however, as banks that had oversold U.S. currency jumped back into the market to buy.
Dealers reported an above-average 352 trades for $172 million and said the peso hit an intraday high of 1,074.50 and a low of 1,077.80. ((-- Nelson Bocanegra, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
